citation: State of MP v. Sunita Bai (2020) 14 SCC 123
reasoning_summary: Acquittal as dying declaration was contradictory and medical evidence suggested accidental burns. Prosecution witnesses gave inconsistent testimony. Benefit of doubt given to accused.

facts_established.actus_reus: Death by burns but circumstances unclear
facts_established.mens_rea: Not proven - could be accident or suicide
facts_established.chain_of_custody: Weak - no direct evidence of abetment
